name: web readable stream
source: import { ReadableStream } from 'node:stream/web'; async function main(): Promise<void> { const stream = new ReadableStream({ start(controller) { controller.enqueue('hello'); controller.close(); } }); const reader = stream.getReader(); const first = await reader.read(); const last = await reader.read(); console.log(first.value, first.done, last.done); }
